# Ming Yi Lim

> Singapore-based growth and lifecycle marketer with 10+ years across B2B, DTC and B2B2C in APAC. Builds AI-native marketing systems: SEO/GEO, Klaviyo lifecycle automation, Shopify Admin API workflows and documented rulesets run with Claude Code and MCP. Fluent in English, Mandarin and Malay.

## Selected work

- Hyve Promo (2025–2026): Built the marketing stack across 7 APAC markets. Took a new domain from zero to 30,000+ search impressions in six months and earned a cited-source position in Perplexity for category queries. Built six Klaviyo lifecycle flows (welcome, cart and browse abandonment, post-purchase, winback).
- Best World International (2021–2025): Go-to-market execution across 13+ international regions, including Australia and the USA.
- Fill Apac (2019–2021): Grew e-commerce revenue 200% year on year and improved ROAS 50%.
